services.desc: The Kid Clinic is a partnership between the Campbell County School District and Campbell County Health. It's located on Kendrick Avenue near Twin Spruce Junior High. The clinic serves children ages two weeks old to 21 years old and provides counseling services to those 4 years old through 21 years old.
